title: Bank act body
description: The active Bank (register row DK1458; spec-delta S1405; the owner's decision of 2026-11-21). `deposit`: the holder puts credits at the Bank, with no lock. `withdraw`: the holder takes some back; what the Bank cannot pay at once is paid in the order asked as loans come back. `borrow` and `repay`: the Treasury borrows from the Bank (at most 50 % of what the Bank holds, the Bank lending at most 70 % of what it holds) and pays back. `interest`: the Treasury pays one completed ISO week's interest (0.25 % of what it owes), only from that week's income, the unpaid part carrying to the next week; the Bank keeps 20 % and pays the rest to its depositors by balance and days held. Every act moves credits that already exist: no mint, supply unchanged. Credits are accounting entries, not money. Chain: none (prev is null).
